description: Open Canton Dev Fund proposals that nothing has happened on for at least a number of days (no human comment, review or board move), oldest first, grouped by who the next step is on: the applicant (the committee asked for changes), the committee (someone is assigned or it is ready for a vote), nobody picked it up (no champion, no reviewer), or a vote. Each item states the reason in plain words and who acted last. Proposals whose board history is incomplete are listed apart as unplaced. Use for "what is stuck and on whom". Canton-specific.

limit.description: How many proposals. Default 20, max 50. The response states the full count.

stuck_days.description: Idle for at least this many days. Default 30.

waiting_on.description: Only proposals whose next step is on this side.

name: list_stuck_proposals
